entries.source: An Elven corruptor, drawn to these blighted lands.
entries.target: 一位精灵腐化者，被这片枯萎之地所吸引。

entries.source:
Conjures %d missile-shaped rocks that you target individually at any target or targets in range.  Each missile deals %0.2f physical damage, and an additional %0.2f bleeding damage every turn for 5 turns.
		At talent level 5, you can conjure one additional missile.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
释放出 %d 个岩石飞弹射向任意射程内的目标。每个飞弹造成 %0.2f 物理伤害和每回合 %0.2f 流血伤害，持续 5 回合。
		在等级 5 时，你可以额外释放一个飞弹。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: A creature stands before you, with long tentacle-like appendages and a squat bump in place of a head. An intense aura of power radiates from this being unlike anything you've ever felt before. It can only be a Sher'Tul. A living Sher'Tul!
entries.target: 四肢是触须，头部由某种突起代替的奇怪生物。一种强烈的能量在他周围流动，这股能量不同于你之前认识的任何一种。他只能是夏·图尔人。一名活生生的夏·图尔人！

entries.source: Terrain prevents #Source# from switching places with #Target#.

entries.target: 暴击时 闪电溅射伤害

entries.source: You do not have enough ammo left!
Increases the effectiveness of all healing the target receives by %d%%.
entries.target: 提升目标受到的所有治疗效果 %d%%。

entries.source: Improves senses, allowing the detection of unseen things.
entries.target: 强化感知，可以看到看不到的东西

entries.source: Basic tactic: Do not get surrounded

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 魔法，+0 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.source: You can't cast this on friendly targets.
entries.target: 该技能不能对友军释放。

entries.source: A dead green worm, painstakingly separated from its tangle of companions.
entries.target: 一只死掉的绿色虫子，需要非常仔细才能把它从蠕虫团中挑拣出来。
